* Mordan8
* Here, one of the Main Factions (commonwealth, phannon and yaki) patrol has identified a hostile ship (Pirate, War Target, etc).
* Normally, we'd just attack right away, but if this target is a Player Ship equipped with a Software Signature Disruptor, we want to SEVERELY
* hinder the A.I. patrol from attacking it. It's possible for a player owned ship to bail and for an A.I. to salvage it, and the A.I. should
* not receive this benefit, so we check that the owner is the player also.
* Regarding Aggression, there is little info, but normal patrol aggression should be between 60-90. Here, we have a small chance that our covert
* ship will be engaged (10%) and we also set the AI attacking ship aggression level down to 25, making the pilot very unwilling to engage, even
* when ordered to do so. Not tested, but the docs show this behavior so we'll see.
* Attack as normal.

Zero Hour 1.8 - for the player its not illegal to carry Space Weed, etc.
Here, one of the Main Factions (commonwealth, phannon and yaki) patrol has identified a hostile ship (Pirate, War Target, etc).
Normally, we'd just attack right away, but if this target is a Player Ship equipped with a Software Signature Disruptor, we want to SEVERELY
hinder the A.I. patrol from attacking it. It's possible for a player owned ship to bail and for an A.I. to salvage it, and the A.I. should
not receive this benefit, so we check that the owner is the player also.
Regarding Aggression, there is little info, but normal patrol aggression should be between 60-90. Here, we have a small chance that our covert
ship will be engaged (10%) and we also set the AI attacking ship aggression level down to 25, making the pilot very unwilling to engage, even
when ordered to do so. Not tested, but the docs show this behavior so we'll see.
Attack as normal.
